history.summary: A large 560 sqft 1BR at The Mezzo (D12 Balestier, freehold, 2014) at $888k / $1,586 PSF — listed ~6% below the URA median of $1,691 PSF. Honest resale-to-resale appreciation is only 2.75%/yr over 30 transactions, a soft growth rate that defines the case.
history.rating_rationale: Priced $1,586 PSF vs $1,691 URA median is a genuine ~6% discount and the 560 sqft is a usable 1BR (not a shoebox), with a credible 30-txn data series. But the resale-only appreciation of 2.75%/yr is well below the RCR/CCR ~4.5-5.8% range — capital upside is the binding constraint. Freehold and sub-$900k quantum support liquidity, but the weak appreciation keeps it Neutral.
red_flags: Resale appreciation only 2.75%/yr — below regional baselines
970m (12 min) walk to Farrer Park MRT
catalysts: Listed ~6% under $1,691 URA median PSF — room to the area's going rate
